entities.name: Kauri Kõiv
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kauri Kõiv is a former Estonian biathlete. At the 2010 Winter Olympics in Vancouver, he finished 14th in the 4×7.5 km relay, 44th in the 20 km individual, 48th in the 10 km sprint and 50th in the 12.5 km pursuit. He represented Estonia at the 2014 Winter Olympics and 2018 Winter Olympics.
